mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 320 signals rising inflation expectations, leading to risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the inflation signal does not precede returns in a lagged regression.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in demand (GDPC1) outpacing supply growth (INDPRO) creates upward pressure on prices, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increasing while INDPRO increasing at a slower rate
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression, or 60-day returns do not exceed baseline in such scenarios.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in PAYEMS (labor participation) during a post-recession labor market expansion period drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as improved labor conditions boost corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not rise significantly above baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during the identified labor expansion phase.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% triggers a tightening cycle, raising borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns do not turn negative when the trigger occurs, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in UNRATE above 4.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing growth prospects and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns do not turn negative when the trigger occurs, or the relationship is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in both GDPC1 (total personal consumption) and HOUST (industrial production) signal robust demand growth, driving up corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression, or 20-day returns do not exceed baseline in such cases.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in demand (GDPC1) outpacing supply growth (INDPRO) creates upward price pressure, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increasing while INDPRO increasing at a slower rate
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression, or 60-day returns do not exceed baseline in such scenarios.
